name: Tamarin Lava Escapists VR
summary:
Tamarin Lava Escapists is an exciting VR game where you play as a tamarin trying to escape rising lava. The game uses gorilla-style locomotion, so you’ll swing, climb, and leap your way through dangerous terrain.

The world is vibrant and full of challenges, from tricky jumps to intense multiplayer competitions. Every level keeps you on edge as the lava closes in. It’s fast-paced, fun, and really tests your skills. If you’re up for a challenge and love action-packed VR, this game is for you!
